note: Self-reported / crowdsourced usage observations read off the provider's own usage screen (claude.ai, ChatGPT, Claude Code, etc.). These are REAL observed data points about chat-subscription caps that no API exposes: what a plan actually allowed before it throttled, or the usage screen's reading at a moment in time. Each report records what was seen, not an inferred cap. Empty until the first reading is added; the site hides the section while empty. Add a report by appending an object to `reports`.

fields.surface: where it was read: claude.ai | desktop | Claude Code | chatgpt.com
fields.window: the cap window this observes: 5h | week | day | month
fields.captured_at: ISO timestamp when the reading was taken
fields.reset_at: ISO timestamp the window resets (optional, if shown)
fields.metric: what the number means: messages | percent | tokens
fields.observed: numeric value of metric at capture (e.g. messages sent before the cap, or % used)
fields.limit_hit: true if this reading is the point the cap actually throttled
fields.note: verbatim wording from the usage screen + any context
fields.usage_tokens: optional {input, output, cache_write, cache_read} token counts for the session
fields.api_equiv_usd: optional number: what this usage would cost at the model's API rate (a value comparison, not the cap)
fields.api_equiv_basis: optional string documenting the pricing used for api_equiv_usd

reports.note: Single continuous session from 0% at window start. 385 Opus turns over ~1h02m reached 75% of the 5h cap (in-app indicator; may lag a few min). Session token usage: 283,476 output + 36,742 fresh input + 3,341,442 cache-write + 50,597,493 cache-read tokens. Priced at the Opus 4.8 API rate (input $5, output $25, 5-min cache-write $6.25, cache-read $0.50 per 1M), that is ~$53 of API-equivalent value for 75% of the window, implying ~$71 of API-equivalent Opus usage per full 5h window on a $20/mo Pro plan. (API-equivalent is a value comparison; the actual cap mechanic is not published.)
reports.api_equiv_basis: Opus 4.8 API rate: input $5, output $25, 5-min cache-write $6.25, cache-read $0.50 per 1M tokens. Value comparison, not the cap mechanic.
reports.evidence: Claude Code session transcript + in-app 5h usage indicator

reports.note: Personal Pro account, weekly cap at 78% (in-app indicator). MEASURED FLOOR from local Claude Code transcripts (~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl), deduped by message.id, for the active weekly window (reset Wed 2026-06-03 17:00 EDT). SCOPED to personal projects only (path match 'personal'), because this machine also ran a SEPARATE work Pro login this week whose Claude Code burn hits a different account's cap. Attribution is a weak proxy: Claude Code's login is global per instance, not per project, so a personal-project session could have run on the work login (or vice-versa); transcripts record no account identity. Also excludes claude.ai web/desktop chat, which counts against this same cap. So the figure is a soft lower bound. 1,627 assistant turns: Opus 4.8 ($117), Sonnet 4.6 ($35), Haiku 4.5 ($0.41). At Anthropic API list rates that is ~$153 of API-equivalent value at 78%, implying a full weekly Claude Code budget of >=~$197 API-equivalent on a $20/mo Pro plan. (API-equivalent is a value comparison; the cap mechanic is not published.)
reports.api_equiv_basis: Anthropic API list price per model (Opus 4.8 in $5 / out $25 / cw-5m $6.25 / cw-1h $10 / cr $0.50; Sonnet 4.6 $3/$15/$3.75/$6/$0.30; Haiku 4.5 $1/$5/$1.25/$2/$0.10 per 1M). See scripts/cc-usage.mjs. Value comparison, not the cap mechanic.
reports.evidence: Aggregated ~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl assistant-turn usage via scripts/cc-usage.mjs --since 2026-06-03T21:00:00Z --match personal, deduped by message.id. Paired with in-app weekly % indicator. Scoped to personal projects as a weak account proxy (see note).

reports.note: SEPARATE work Pro account (also $20/mo), read off the in-app Plan-usage panel: weekly 'all models' 79%, resets in ~1 day (exact reset time not shown). Same panel showed the 5-hour limit at 7% (resets ~4h) and a usage-credits pool at $0.00 of $40.00. Recorded as an OBSERVED-ONLY receipt: no measured-burn pairing, because (1) this machine ran two Claude logins this week and transcripts carry no account identity, and (2) the work weekly window's reset time is unknown, so per-account burn can't be scoped to the right window. The observed % is a real reading; any $ figure would be a guess on a guess.
reports.evidence: In-app Claude Code Plan-usage panel screenshot (work account): 5-hour 7% resets 4h; Weekly all models 79% resets 1d; usage credits $0.00 of $40.00; context 82.5k/1.0M.
